# All your teams. All your AI agents. One place to run customer work, together.

Bring support, sales, operations, and AI agents together to resolve every request and build stronger customer relationships, from first hello to renewal.

![AI command center](https://front.com/assets/pages/homepage/home-hero-first-frame.png)

## Customer work isn’t a single-player game. With Front, your teams and agents work as one.

### No more dropped handoffs

Coordinate escalations and smooth handoffs across teams and agents.

### Nobody answers half-informed

See the full customer history across conversations, decisions, and next steps.

### Score every team and agent. Even theirs.

See how your teams and agents are performing and pinpoint what to improve.

## Other platforms are built for simple tickets. Front is built for complex customer work.

Integrations

## Your tools, synced into every conversation

Reduce context switching and power workflow automations with 160+ out-of-the-box integrations. Don’t see your system? Build a no-code integration directly in Front.

![Integrations](https://front.com/staticwebassets/storybook-assets/integrations/integrations-cloud.svg)

## Get customer work done with your teams and agents. Come to Front.

![](https://front.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffront.com%2Fstaticwebassets%2Fstorybook-assets%2Fcta-section%2Fcta-section-image-slot.png&w=1080&q=75)
